title: Chicken & Sweet Corn Soup
description: Chinese-style chicken and corn soup with egg ribbons, made start to finish in the Thermomix. High in protein and on the table in about 35 minutes.

confidence.note: Built from technique. Not yet cooked; the poaching time and cornflour amount are a starting point.

steps.title: Chop
steps.text: Add the spring onion whites, garlic ({{garlic}} cloves) and ginger ({{ginger}}) to the bowl. Chop 3 sec / Speed 7. Scrape down.

steps.title: Sauté
steps.text: Add the oil ({{oil}}). Sauté 2 min / 120°C / Speed 1.

steps.title: Poach the chicken
steps.text: Add the stock ({{stock}}). Put the chicken ({{chicken}}) in the simmering basket and insert it into the bowl. Cook 15 min / 100°C / Speed 1, until the chicken reaches 75°C in the thickest part.

steps.title: Shred
steps.text: Lift out the basket and shred the chicken with two forks.

steps.title: Add the corn
steps.text: Add the creamed corn ({{creamed-corn}}), corn kernels ({{corn}}), soy ({{soy}}), white pepper ({{white-pepper}}) and the shredded chicken. Cook 5 min / 100°C / Reverse / Soft stir.

steps.title: Thicken
steps.text: Mix the cornflour ({{cornflour}}) with the cold water ({{water}}) until smooth. Add to the bowl and cook 3 min / 100°C / Reverse / Speed 1, until the soup turns glossy and coats the spatula.

steps.title: Egg ribbons
steps.text: Set 2 min / 90°C / Reverse / Soft stir. Once it is running, pour the beaten eggs ({{eggs}}) slowly onto the lid so they run into the soup in thin threads.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Stir through the sesame oil ({{sesame-oil}}). Taste, adding a splash more soy if needed, and serve topped with the spring onion greens ({{spring-onion}} spring onions in total).

notes.title: Capacity
notes.text: These amounts land around 1.9L, close to the bowl limit. Do not scale up.

notes.title: Leftover chicken
notes.text: Skip the poaching. Add the stock and corn together, then 250g shredded cooked chicken at step 5. Barbecue chicken works well.

notes.title: Salt
notes.text: Stock, creamed corn and soy all carry salt, so none is added. Taste at the end.

notes.title: Freezing
notes.text: Freezes well, though the egg ribbons go a little softer. Reheat gently and do not boil hard.
